key_reasoning.reason: Three filter hooks (useAnalyticsFilters, useLeaderboardFilters, useProjectsFilters) plus four consumers (AnalyticsPage, AnalyticsFilters, LeaderboardTab, ProjectsManagementFull) across two product areas (analytics, settings/projects administration), and the shared src/utils/filters.ts (new FILTER_ENTITY entries, getFilterStorageKey, per-entity FilterKeys). Base M, bumped to L for touching a core shared utility.

Diffstat reports 15 files changed (946 insertions, 94 deletions): 7 production files modified, 2 new hooks (useLeaderboardFilters, useProjectsFilters) and 6 test files, in 3+ directory trees (src/pages/analytics, src/pages/settings/administration/projectsManagement, src/utils). 15 files maps to XL under the actual-mode rule.

Closest pattern is the existing getFilters/setFilters URL+localStorage persistence used by other list pages. It does not cover validation of untrusted URL query values, and the new sanitizeUrlFilters / isValidISODate / parseBudgetCategory / parseSort per-field validation is a divergence, so the score was bumped from S to M. The URL-echo vs restore detection (ownWriteRef), debounced apply and effect-loop avoidance add moderate behavioural risk but no performance or rollback concern. Calibration: agrees with the bundled M example epmcdme-10203 (total 15) and stays clearly below the L example epmcdme-10401, which carried a config migration.
